Good afternoon evening crew,
Short evening so far, and the night supervisor discussed a concern about kennel cleaning

Team,

Please treat this as an urgent reminder from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. We have had a few close calls with handoffs that looked orderly at first glance but did not hold up once the welfare checks were reviewed. The standard now is simple: every carrier, mat, latch, and lining must be checked before the animal moves, and any sign of residue or dampness must be escalated at once. <<FACT F042>> We cannot afford shortcuts when the handoff is already under pressure, especially when the ground team is moving carriers between services and the welfare coordinator is waiting for a clean confirmation.

Also, keep the lounge flow tight and verbalize what you see before you release anything back into circulation. <<FACT F019>> If a carrier arrives with debris, a loose fastener, or an odor that suggests the kennel was not cleared properly, stop the process and report it immediately. The next team should never inherit a problem without a clear note attached, and the handover record must reflect what was actually done, not what was assumed. This is especially important when passengers are anxious and looking for reassurance about their animal's comfort.

Finally, use careful wording with travelers and keep internal updates concise. <<FACT F002>> If you need support, bring the issue to the senior coordinator right away rather than trying to smooth it over on your own. We need disciplined follow-through, consistent cleaning checks, and fast escalation whenever a standard is missed. Please apply this tonight without delay, and make sure every closing task is completed before you sign off.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
